verses.text: But you must teach what agrees with healthy teaching.
Teach the older men to control themselves, to be worthy of respect, and to think clearly. Teach them to be strong in faith, in love and in keeping going.
In the same way, teach the older women to live in a way that honours God. They must not spread lies about others or be slaves to much wine. They must teach what is good.
Then they can train the younger women to love their husbands and their children,
to think clearly and be pure, to work well at home, to be kind, and to accept the leadership of their own husbands. Then no one will speak badly of God's word.
In the same way, encourage the young men to think clearly and control themselves.
In everything, set them an example by doing what is good. When you teach, be honest and serious, and keep your teaching pure.
Speak in a healthy way that no one can criticise. Then anyone who opposes you will be ashamed, because they will have nothing bad to say about us.
Teach slaves to obey their own masters and to please them in everything. They must not talk back to them,
or steal from them. Instead, they must show that they can be fully trusted. Then in every way they will make the teaching about God our Saviour attractive.
For the grace of God has appeared, and it brings salvation to all people.
It teaches us to say "No" to ungodly living and to worldly desires. It teaches us to live in this world with self-control, doing what is right and living for God.
We do this while we wait for the blessed hope, when the glory of our great God and Saviour, Jesus Christ, will appear.
He gave himself for us to set us free from all evil, and to make us pure, a people who belong to him alone and who are eager to do good.
Teach these things. Encourage people and correct them with full authority. Do not let anyone look down on you.
